definitions.explanation: Reading only selected parts of a text rather than the whole thing, picking out what seems interesting or relevant. Literally 'picking-up reading.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拾|ひろ}い{読|よ}み⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧{拾|ひろ}い{読|よ}みしか⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I didn't have time and could only skim through it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拾|ひろ}い{読|よ}み⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I skimmed the report and checked only the important parts.

notes:
USAGE:
Suggests a quick, selective style of reading rather than careful, thorough reading. Not necessarily negative — sometimes practical when short on time. Can be used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拾|ひろ}い{読|よ}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to skim, to browse)
- {拾|ひろ}い{読|よ}みしか⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (can only skim)
- ざっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{拾|ひろ}い{読|よ}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to quickly skim through)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{斜|なな}め{読|よ}み→斜め読み：22744_nanameyomi⟧: speed-reading, skimming — similar meaning, literally 'diagonal reading'
- ⟦{流|なが}し{読|よ}み→流し読み：21428_nagashiyomi⟧: cursory reading — reading quickly without focusing
